reviews.text: I really appreciate Dr. Wiles and Mere for taking the time to drive to my fur babies and I to make sure they are okay! They took over for Readivet and it was truly such an easy process for me! My two cats are a little harder to handle and they were so so patient with them and super reassuring for my anxiety! They rock! Mobile Vets are truly a lifesaver for anxious cats and dogs (and any other furry friend!)

Dr. Desiraye Paredes was incredible. She came so quickly and was so kind and thorough. She treated my great dane who is very scared of needles and vets and this was the best visit we have ever had. I have never had a vet go through so much care and time to explain everything. Highly recommend!
Dr. Wiles & Mere are passionate & kind towards our dogs & patient with their humans :)  Thorough visit and excellent communication before and after appointment.  Highly recommend!

Dr. Wiles and Mere were amazing! They were quick with their examination and very gentle with my pet. They explained everything throughly and gave us lots of tips to help my pet in the long-run. It was super affordable, too!

First time meeting Dr Wiles and her assistant and our visit was wonderful. They took great care of my two pups and for that I’m grateful. Will be calling soon!! Hazel is feeling much better thank you!

We love Mere and Dr. Wiles! They are both incredibly patient and kind. And it’s so nice not to have to stress out our two rescue dogs with waiting and exam rooms. Everything happens here at home! (Photo of our dogs pretending to be well behaved.)
Very friendly and professional

I highly recommend Blue Sky!  They have always been very responsive and shown so much TLC to our little dog.  We had Dr. Wiles who was great.  When it was time to put our fur baby down, Dr. Mitra came and was so compassionate and kind!  He did not rush the process and stayed with us for an hour.  He did an amazing job and everything went so well.  Thank you to Dr. Mitra and the nurse that came with him!!

I don’t even know where to begin. Dr Key, Shelby, and Sam have been absolutely fabulous. After another veterinarian told me that Athena was too aggressive for him to see, I was extremely anxious about having a veterinarian come to our home to examine her.

The entire team made this process so incredibly easy and completely stress-free. From start to finish, I felt comfortable, supported, and had absolutely no anxiety. They were patient, understanding, and so wonderful with Athena.

I’m beyond thankful for the care they provided and truly cannot recommend this amazing team enough. Thank y’all so much! ❤️

We had our first home visit with the mobile vet service yesterday and couldn't be happier. Dr. Key and Shelby provided truly excellent care. They were both incredibly attentive, professional, and made the entire process so easy for us and our big boy!  Highly recommend!

I have two boy Cavalier King Charles Spaniels and they are very reactive dogs to other dogs and just generally super dramatic, so we always dread vet visits. Charlie had some weird scabs on his neck so we got Dr. Key and Shelby to come over and it was FANTASTIC. The boys instantly loved them (one immediately laid in Dr. Key's lap-it was precious) and they made everything so easy. They even got them caught up on late shots right there in the living room and provided shampoo for the scabs. This is one of the best in home services out there and I am going to make sure everyone knows it!!
Great vet service especially if you have a cat who stresses out and will claw a person to shreds if you try to take her outside!
Ladies were fabulous with my pitty, she loved the treats! Dr was very informative!!

Dr. Wiles and Mere were wonderful! They were so patient with my cats and you could genuinely tell how much they cared about making them feel comfortable. Having them come to the house made the whole experience so much less stressful, and I really appreciated how kind and thorough they both were. Highly recommend!

I had a wonderful experience with BlueSky! I have an anxious kitty who has been turned away at multiple vet offices, but the team at BlueSky made him feel so comfortable in his own home. We were able to complete his vaccines with ease, it's such a relief to know this form of vet-care is available!
Dr Meyers was so great and patient with our giant great Pyrenees anxious guy!  We love them

5 stars for Meredith and Dr. Wiles...they were SO patient and sat down to chat and that helped lessen my dog's anxieties... They were thorough with her annual wellness check and I was very happy with the overall experience.  I highly recommend them.
I am not giving 5 stars to the Bluesky company YET because they do have to iron out some kinks in their phone/website appointment and their shipment of medicine.  They took over readivet and I do understand that it make take some time for them to operate smoothly.

Two stars because one someone actually gets to the house, the people who do the vet visits are nice and good.

But getting a person is a mess.

Scheduling an appointment is a multi-day, multi-message hassle. They want you to be available all day, and only confirm a two-hour window the day before.

I work from home, so I have some flexibility, but I frequently have client meetings, which means I have to accommodate their schedules. I can't just block a whole day of my calendar during the workweek.

I can't imagine how anyone who "goes to work" can make this work.

Even when I try to be proactive and flexible — booking four weeks in advance, saying "Any time this day except for two 30-minute windows" — they can't work with that:

"It depends on what other appointments are scheduled that day because we need to make sure the team is not bouncing back and forth across the city."

No offer of a different day. Or time window available adjacent to another nearby appointment. No offer of solution. Just the verbal equivalent of a shrug.

It's obvious that they don't have their scheduling operations figured out at all, so they're just shoving the work and inconvenience of those logistics onto the clients. For a company whose entire business model is based on higher prices for convenience, it is absurd how inconvenient it is to get an appointment to give them money.

Customer service is non-existent. You must suffer an inept AI-bot to "schedule" an appointment. Unfortunately, the appointment isn't really scheduled -- it is only a request. You have to wait until the day prior for confirmation and to get a two hour window.

Need to speak to a human? Forget it! I've yet to reach a human via telephone. I am trying to work around a travel schedule but I cannot get anyone on the phone.

Need to modify or cancel an appointment? You must call -- appointment requests cannot be modified or canceled online.

BlueSky's answer to this horrible service? Send us an e-mail. I have a better suggestion: find a different veterinarian.

I have been quite disappointed in Blue Sky At Home mobile service since they took over ReadiVet of Collin County. I had used ReadiVet for a few years and very disappointed when they were bought out by BlueSkyAtHome.  I was hesitant to try BlueSkyAtHome but since I have a dog with severe anxiety, he needs to be sedated just for regular vet visits, I wanted to give them a try.
With the previous ReadiVet Collin County it was easy to book, vets and techs were professional and always extremely caring and friendly. They never gave me any issues about this type of service requested. However, it hasn’t  been the same experience with BlueSky At Home. My dog actually has a medical issue with his anal glands and needs a regular expression every (4-6 weeks) to prevent his getting impacted.
I had BlueSkyAtHome come to do this service but was told prior to the first visit, I needed to make a complete physical first so the vet would get to know our dogs. So I did this. I don’t mind paying the higher fees for this particular service and having it done in our home which is less stressful for all of us. However making a appt was not the easiest experience. I made it online, but never received a confirmation. A few days later, Samantha contacted me to say they don’t offer this service and I need to contact a groomer instead. This is a medical issue my dog has and needs expression to prevent chronic impaction, infection, or rupture. My previous vets (ReadiVet) informed me groomers don’t do the same full expression and to make sure to get it done professionally by a vet or tech. It’s a shame this new clinic doesn’t offer the same compassionate and quality of care as ReadiVet. What a disappointment.
Good luck getting ahold of anyone. Called 10+ times with no answer

My cat's vet recently got bought out by this company. I am not happy with how impersonal their approach to care is. I have not been able to get ahold on ANYONE and get sent immediately to an AI phone tree. Only for it to ring for 1 minute until forced to leave a voicemail. When I need to speak to someone, no one is there. What can I do to get a call about my 19 year old cat who needs care?? I submitted an appointment "request" 2 hours ago with no confirmation. Basically just talking to a wall with this place.

First of all, I’ve never used a mobile pet service before now and was extremely pleased with the entire process. Dr. Wiles and Mere came to see our senior dog last week and I can’t not express enough as to how wonderful these 2 are! They treated our little ole man with such kindness and compassion. They were so patient with him when he needed it most. They took their time and listened to my concerns and answered all of my questions. Their follow up has been impeccable. If you are looking for a mobile vet - look no further! You won’t regret it!

We are so pleased to have started working with BlueSky. They were knowledgeable, friendly, and professional. I feel like they are more proactive than our previous vet and that our old dogs are in good hands.
Great conversations and during the exam the competency was very high and the ease  Of drawing blood was amazing so says our dog ... Doctor Wiles and Meredith make a great team!

We cannot recommend Blue Sky at-home veterinary care highly enough! We have two very large Irish Wolfhounds who absolutely refuse to get into a vehicle, so this service has truly been a lifesaver for our family. Scheduling appointments is simple, they always arrive on time, and we love that they send alerts when they’re on the way.

What really sets them apart is the care and attention they give to our dogs. Nothing ever feels rushed — they take the time to get to know your pets, make them feel comfortable, and even come prepared with pockets full of treats! Their compassion, professionalism, and convenience are unmatched. We are so grateful to have found this wonderful service.

Dr. Wiles and Mere came by and conducted my dog's wellness exam.  They both seemed eager to meet AnnaBelle and kept her relaxed during the entire procedure.  Clearly they both love the animals they work with.  Dr Wiles has seen AnnaBelle previosly and has always been great to work with.
Great visit for my 2 slightly neurotic dogs.

Fantastic first visit for my sick cat.  I've used a mobile network service before and prefer this style appointment when possible. Dr. Wiles and Mere were delightful and helpful. They said hi to my other pet and even provided a treat so he wouldn't feel left out. They checked out my sick baby girl and gave her a shot. They provided a calm demeanor and a treat packet. She was comfortable and liked them.  Result: my new veterinary service.  Yay!

The Veterinarian Dr. Mitra and his vet tech Tara are excellent. I would absolutely recommend them to care for your animals. I can’t say enough how appreciative I am and  the kindness and gentleness with my dogs!!!
